items.title: Monster Beverage (MNST) Took A $19.9 Million Property Impairment In The Third Quarter
items.summary: Monster Beverage (NasdaqGS:MNST) booked a significant impairment charge on property and equipment in its third quarter results. The write down reflects a revised assessment of certain asset values on the company’s balance sheet for the period. Management flagged the impairment as a material item for shareholders reviewing Monster Beverage’s recent quarter.
